title: 1 倒计时01
content_zh:
心跳却又异常地快，不知是因为昨晚熬了夜，还是今天喝了太多咖啡。
服务员在收银台看到订单，特意走过来问：“女士，您今天下午已经喝了三杯咖啡了，不如换一杯果汁吧？”
现在已经六点，这栋写字楼的员工都开始陆陆续续下班了，菲菲嘴里的“会议”还没结束。
哪怕人家都没有安排她上楼的意思，就把她晾在这里，倪夏也只能忍气吞声。
明明不久前，她还是意气风发的新秀导演，为了即将开机的电影《贝莉的海底世界》忙得脚不沾地。
虽然没有大IP大卡司，但这个项目她和好朋友谷雨声打磨了四年，从剧本到特效，每一步都仔细把关，整个主创团队都迫切地想把这个充满想象力的科幻故事搬上荧幕。
可就在倪夏和谷雨声满心欢喜地和酒店确认开机宴的菜品时，突然收到了中悦汇投决定撤资的消息。
没有任何预兆，也没有清晰的解释，她再怎么挣扎，也只能眼睁睁看着酒店退租，设备撤走，演员一个个进了别的组。
一会儿说公司资金链出现问题，一会儿又说公司最近对这个项目的市场和预期还有之前谈判的情况有不同意见。
倪夏成宿成宿地失眠，现在只能狼狈地等在他们公司楼下，只为要到救命的二期投资款。
眼看着咖啡厅的人快走完了，从写字楼出来的人也越来越多，菲菲还是没回微信。
【菲菲】：真是不好意思，我今天太忙了给忘了。这会儿我已经去见一个客户了，这可咋办。
不知是三杯咖啡带来的心悸，还是苦等一下午的怨气爆发，倪夏感觉自己的手都在发抖。
这段时间一次次的打击让倪夏实在心力交瘁，有一种坠入水井，四肢撑着井壁努力往上爬，却依然止不住下坠的感觉。
content_en:
But my heartbeat is unusually fast. I don't know if it's because I stayed up late last night or drank too much coffee today.
When the waiter saw the order at the cashier, he came over and asked: "Madam, you have already drank three cups of coffee this afternoon. How about a glass of juice instead?"
It's now six o'clock, and the employees in this office building are starting to get off work one after another, and the "meeting" Feifei talks about is not over yet.
Even if they had no intention of arranging for her to go upstairs and just left her here, Ni Xia could only swallow her anger.
Apparently not long ago, she was a high-spirited new director, busy working on the upcoming movie "Bailey's Underwater World".
Although there is no big IP or big cast, she and her good friend Gu Yusheng have been working on this project for four years, carefully checking every step from the script to the special effects. The entire creative team is eager to put this imaginative science fiction story on the screen.
But just when Ni Xia and Gu Yusheng were happily confirming the dishes for the opening banquet with the hotel, they suddenly received the news that Zhongyue Hui Investment had decided to divest.
There was no warning or clear explanation. No matter how hard she struggled, she could only watch as the hotel was canceled, the equipment was removed, and the actors joined other groups one by one.
At one moment, it was said that there was a problem in the company's capital chain, and at another moment, it was said that the company had recently had different opinions on the market and expectations of this project, as well as the situation of previous negotiations.
Ni Xiacheng has been suffering from insomnia for a long time, and now he can only wait in embarrassment downstairs of their company, just to get the life-saving second phase of investment funds.
Seeing that the people in the coffee shop were almost gone and more and more people were coming out of the office building, Feifei still didn't reply to WeChat.
[Feifei]: I'm so sorry, I was so busy today that I forgot. Now I have gone to meet a client, what should I do?
Whether it was the palpitations caused by three cups of coffee or the resentment she had been waiting for all afternoon to burst out, Ni Xia felt her hands trembling.
The repeated blows during this period made Ni Xia really exhausted mentally and physically. She felt like she had fallen into a well, holding her limbs on the walls of the well and trying to climb up, but she still couldn't stop falling.
